H-LOG 2026.08.11 [EN]

📈 [2026-08-11 16:07]

H-LOG: Professionals Report

the cash session (Spot)

  • Index situation: The market is in a consolidation phase with a slight bullish bias (NDX +0.19%, NQ +0.14%, QQQ +0.14%). Despite positive price changes, the cumulative energy flow (CVD) across all instruments is negative (NDX: -29,31 M, QQQ: -1,13 M, NQ: -14,42 K), suggesting selling pressure or profit-taking while levels are being sustained by passive buy orders.
  • Sentiment and broad market: The aggregate flow direction indicator is 0, indicating total neutrality and a lack of a clear direction in capital inflow. The Background Radiation (TICKQ) at the 93.00 level is significantly below the SMA200 average (116.47), signaling a weakening of market dynamics in a broad sense.
  • QQQ options analysis: The options market shows a tilt towards short positions (Put/Call Ratio = 1.11), which with a volume of 490,523 contracts indicates increased hedging or expectations of a correction. Implied volatility (IV) at the 20.80% level and the projected movement range between 714.54 – 726.84 suggest a concentration of liquidity within a narrow price range.
